Scholar Jeremiah Johnston joins Tucker Carlson to talk about the Shroud of Turin, the Dead Sea Scrolls, and bids to hide proof of Jesus. Johnston is a scholar of the early church and its texts. His case rests on old finds.

Johnston walks through the shroud tests and what the scrolls tell of the world Jesus knew. He argues that proof for the Bible's tale is strong and still grows. Carlson asks why such finds get so little press. Listeners who love Bible lore get a rich hour. The library keeps the talk as a record of his stated case.
